tasks.title: Immediate governance without timelocks
tasks.text: Zero controller delay and no additional LP migration wait are implemented and locally verified. Roles, exact operations, sealing and execution/custody safeguards remain. Independent review, authority selection and live qualification remain open.
acceptance: [Scoped evidence](reports/immediate-governance/VERIFICATION.md): 228 distinct affected Solidity passes, 142 configuration passes, 30 size gates and fresh internal static review. No deployment or independent approval; there is no advance warning window for governance changes.

tasks.title: Independent mint and pool stop controls
tasks.text: Governance can pause new NFT mints independently and disable pool deposits/operations without token, price or venue calls. Reopening still requires full pool validation; existing rights and lifecycle guards remain. The confirmed API reports mint pause separately.
acceptance: [Scoped verification and internal review](reports/operator-controls/VERIFICATION.md) cover authority, outage/reopen, callback rollback and economic continuity. Production service/authority rehearsals and independent audit remain required; no retroactive change to sealed contracts.

tasks.title: Minting, activation & NFT ownership
tasks.text: 1,000-NFT cap, 0.05 ETH mint and $100 gross-value activation with at least 99% deployed as LP. Rights follow the NFT.

tasks.title: LP fees & separate royalty shares
tasks.text: 80 / 10 / 5 / 5 funded LP allocation with documented raw-unit dust settlement; equal collective shares. Actual royalties go to active NFTs at x1 / x2 / x3, separately from LP shares.

tasks.title: Qualify ETH settlement for marketplace royalties
tasks.text: Bounded batch ETH conversion and optional-currency activation failure isolation are implemented, with a 1% execution-loss cap and gas separate. An opt-in keeper job preserves per-NFT entitlements and existing transaction recovery. Qualify exact Robinhood wrapper/routes/feeds, marketplace receipts, UI/history integration and operating behavior.
acceptance: Keep ETH pricing and verified ETH/WETH as the initial marketplace scope. Verify actual listings/offers/old orders/checkout settlement; a buyer source currency or ETH pricing preference does not prove what reaches the royalty receiver.

Independently review and record the fixed converter binding before sealing, exact wrapper/admin/implementation policies, admitted source currencies, route/factory/pool pins, feeds and final runtime inventory. Stablecoin support remains conditional on actual settlement needs; no live route is assumed.

Implemented: one guarded conversion for up to 32 NFTs' earned balances, proportional ETH credit to those same NFTs, exact WETH unwrap, at least 99% oracle-valued stablecoin output, strict minimum/deadline, approvals/delta checks and separate keeper gas. Original claims/fractions/quarantines remain intact.

Approved and implemented: activation survives optional royalty-token failures; unseen receipts at recovery go to the earlier cohort, then waiting NFTs join future receipts. Expose eligibleFor and deferred/recovered status accurately. Exact unreadable backing still blocks canonical handoff.

Review [scoped tests and internal findings](reports/royalty-conversion/VERIFICATION.md). Rehearse automatic dry/live keeper conversion, gas economics, failed currency/route recovery, mixed claims and successor configuration on the target network; do not infer production readiness from local mocks.

Implemented [backend conversion and currency-eligibility reporting](docs/ROYALTY_REPORTING.md), verified across owners and complete pinned same-chain predecessors. Integrate the website and qualify live ingestion/availability recovery. RoyaltyConverted is not Claimed or new earnings; only actual payouts increase lifetime paid totals. Independent audit/remediation remains required.

tasks.title: Shared LP, maintenance & custody controls
tasks.text: One shared LP per pool/strategy serves many NFTs. The local four-historical-bucket safety bound, permanent allocations, pool-level upkeep, governance approvals, parking and guarded resumption are implemented. Ordinary rebalances now also enforce the user-approved 3% aggregate fixed-start-price cap, retaining existing guards and 5% idle; gas is separate. Approved range changes can now trigger the ordinary keeper rebalance at a flat price after cooldown; successful application clears the mismatch.

tasks.title: Qualify the selected Robinhood pool
tasks.text: The native ETH / Pons adapter and ETH / ZZZ Entry fork tests pass. Independent venue, wrapper and gas review remain.
acceptance: Independently qualify the implemented selected native-ETH/Pons boundary, including wrapper implementation/admin upgrades, native settlement, real-key/accounting mapping and actual-pool tests. Keep production inventory native admission blocked until complete; do not broaden it to arbitrary hooks.

tasks.title: Qualify ETH, ZZZ, USDG & USDC inputs
tasks.text: Asset controls and entry logic exist. A paced read-only USDG/WETH observation verified four conversion quotes; complete source-to-Pons LP execution and production feeds remain unqualified. USDC still needs a reviewed, funded route.
acceptance: Independently verify $100 original source value with at least 99% marginal actually deployed LP, separate network gas, incumbent NAV pricing, all conversion-leg costs, callbacks, pending/dust barriers, top-ups and nonredeemability. Review the immutable Entry's exact owner/calldata context, inactive approval window, Registry-only valuation and callback cleanup; a post-conversion pair value cannot replace original source value.

Review USDC/USDG/ETH/ZZZ source-to-LP routing through the implemented Entry: exact token provenance, actual liquidity, fresh source prices, immutable binding/runtime, original-source budget, exact approvals and complete append-only route history. Native ingress is restricted to the actual native-pool wrapper. USDC remains disabled without a funded reviewed route; unsigned quotes alone do not establish qualified execution.

Use the [integration campaign](docs/INTEGRATION_CAMPAIGN.md) and [read-only observations](reports/activation-route-observation/VERIFICATION.md): one $1 conversion snapshot is not $100 activation qualification. Include subsequent LP costs in the same 1% limit, separate gas, qualified ZZZ pricing and complete operation simulation. Public transaction testing has not run; the isolated $1 build remains local only.

tasks.title: Fair assignment of prepared NFT designs
tasks.text: The fixed 1,000-entry artwork inventory and draw without replacement are implemented. Verifiable randomness assigns a remaining prepared design; it does not generate images or reroll assigned rarity, palette or pattern. Qualify the live randomness service.
acceptance: Independently verify actual supported proof-verifying coordinator code/key/subscription/confirmations/gas and service availability on the deployment chain. An ABI or mock is not verification.
Stage real requests, out-of-order callbacks, strict mint-order reveal, subscription outages, reorg/finality and permanent early-request blocking recovery. No cancellation/reroll/admin bypass exists.
Verify canonical sealing rejects missing randomness configuration; verify content root and every artwork/metadata path against an independently reviewed immutable catalog.

[AUD18-02](reports/daily-security-20261018/REVIEW.md): user selected qualified/funded reliable provider plus stopping new minting and draining original ordered draws before collection replacement. A confirmed readiness endpoint is implemented; qualify actual funding, request latency, alerts and original-provider outage resolution. No reroll/pending-request carry/provider-swap path; a permanently unanswered request still blocks whole-collection replacement, not ordinary LP migration. See [operator policy](docs/OPERATOR_MANUAL.md#mint-and-metadata).

The independent mint-only governance pause and confirmed pause status are implemented; rehearse provider outage, original fulfillment, ordered reveal and deliberate resume. No reroll/provider swap. See [operator controls](reports/operator-controls/VERIFICATION.md).

tasks.title: Design different-pair and future-venue custody evolution
tasks.text: Local same-ordered-pair move/resume now enforces a 3% aggregate execution-loss cap through the immutable Vault-created budget helper, with gas separate. Different pairs and asynchronous bridging still need typed conversion, bounded composition epochs and retained old-currency liabilities before sealing.
acceptance: Preserve stable NFT/bucket/shares and all old owner/collective/royalty liabilities through ZZZ/WETH to ZZZ/USDC and subsequent moves. Token mapping is not conversion; do not remove current pair checks as a shortcut.

Qualify the implemented local movePool/resume 3% aggregate execution-loss cap: snapshot principal and attributed idle before harvest, add only exact released compound, and reuse the initial fresh price/decimal vector after close, balance and mint. Retained LP plus attributed idle must be at least 97%, with the existing 5% idle ceiling under the same vector; gas is separate and activation/top-ups retain 1%. Different-pair and asynchronous bridge costs, funded destination proof and market-movement treatment remain unimplemented and must not inherit this local guarantee.

Define bounded composition/message epochs, historical creator inboxes and reward paths, late old-currency compound/buyback reserves, pending remote funding, exact fixed recipients and temporary approvals. Repeated moves cannot erase or relabel obligations.

Review immutable typed helpers and remote destination compatibility for future venue code without arbitrary calls, principal sweeps or generic upgrades. Same-chain replacement Vaults cannot silently rebind the fixed NFT/Rewards system.

Measure aggregate and cumulative migration costs/frequency; repeated individually compliant 3% moves can substantially erode principal. A new cumulative hard cap or economic allocation change requires a separate policy decision.

areas.title: Backend
areas.caption: The data and services behind the app.

tasks.title: Confirmed balances & ownership API
tasks.text: Confirmed balances, lifecycle guards and complete configured same-chain predecessor claim history are implemented. Lifetime totals include LP fees, royalties and past owners. Hosting, frontend integration and cross-chain history remain separate gates. Current LP ID/share denominator and historical gross contributions are exposed separately from current marked NAV; local custody mismatches fail closed.
acceptance: Eight runtime/address pins, controller/helper bindings and strict lifecycle checks share the confirmed balance snapshot. Frozen/importing/retired/cancelled NFT and wallet projections fail closed; protocol status stays readable without reward/price calls. Operating qualification and consumer integration remain under hosted services and frontend tasks.

Complete explicitly pinned same-chain predecessor history preserves original NFT IDs and lifetime LP plus royalty claims. Verify both handoff directions, canonical matching activation/retirement receipts, terminal roots, historical assets and full creation-to-retirement ingestion. Missing configuration returns unavailable totals; inconsistent configured lineage fails closed. Import transfers are ownership reconstruction, not paid mints or marketplace sales.

Enforce at most eight predecessors and one million configured maximum replay events across current and prior histories. RPC observations and operator ingestion remain the trust model; this backend does not prove consensus finality or implement cross-chain history.

tasks.title: Report royalty eligibility & conversion history
tasks.text: Opt-in confirmed ETH/source balances, deferred currency eligibility and pinned converter enable status are implemented. Complete same-chain event replay separates conversion credits from actual lifetime claims. Missing values stay unavailable; UI, gross earned/USD history and live service qualification remain separate tasks.
acceptance: [Scoped verification](reports/royalty-reporting/VERIFICATION.md): 138 affected Python cases and 20 supplemental cases pass. Forty unchanged Solidity source bindings are reused; ten getter ABIs and 26 added indexer schemas match existing compiler artifacts. No Solidity rerun, public transaction, service deployment or website change.

The profile is explicit and pin-reviewed; legacy contracts do not inherit it. Currency failures do not bypass core identity, lifecycle, canonical freshness, full history coverage or request budgets. Conversion is neither a claim nor new revenue, and native claimable already includes remaining conversion credits.

tasks.title: Prepare unsigned mint & claim requests
tasks.text: Local, unpublished preparation validates and simulates 0.05 ETH mints and up to 32 LP / royalty claims. Signing stays in the wallet; this task is not live integration.

tasks.title: Complete activation & top-up quotes
tasks.text: Full Entry activation/top-up preparation is implemented and locally verified: original-source-to-LP simulation, 1% marginal-deployment floor, exact unsigned calldata and gas separate. Actual production routes, providers and fee semantics still need qualification. Confirmed range and rebalance eligibility/cooldown warnings are included; out-of-range entry remains allowed under normal execution guards. Range-update and price-trigger causes are now distinguished at the confirmed snapshot.
acceptance: Implemented: typed owner request, exact source admission/route/feed/runtime/module pins, one confirmed canonical hash, two full Entry simulations, contract-budget/share/event/LP reconciliation and tighter final conversion/liquidity minima. Missing allowance produces only an exact approval/reset draft and requires re-preparation after confirmation; no state overrides, signer or broadcast.

Qualify actual ETH/ZZZ/USDG/USDC original-source-to-Pons paths and reviewed feeds at $100 gross value, with at least 99% new marginal LP and gas separate. Current local fixtures and trace/budget probe do not constitute a complete live-route rehearsal. Reject or revert when the limit cannot be met; reverted transactions can still spend gas.

Verify intended RPC providers support canonical-hash callTracer with logs and complete gas estimation. Approve network fee accounting (including every applicable data/L1 component), source/proxy/storage pins and actual gas/latency bounds. No latest/state-override fallback on unsupported/stale/future/reorg responses.

Integrate approval confirmation/requote and freshly validated wallet signing/receipts under the frontend task. Display NFT.currentLPValue at the confirmed block separately from marginal new LP and claimable LP/royalty balances; unavailable current value must stay unavailable. Local HTTP preparation is loopback-only; hosting remains under hosted services.

Qualify range/timing output against real StateView ticks and current physical LP IDs. Show cooldown end or eligible-now/waiting state; unknown/stale keeper next-check and execution times must remain unavailable. Reprepare after LP/range/policy changes; Entry calldata has economic minima/deadline, not an LP-version lock. See [dynamic liquidity](docs/DYNAMIC_LIQUIDITY.md).

Implemented request-wide monotonic/expiry/RPC budgets and supervised HTTP workers; [scoped remediation](reports/api-work-limits/VERIFICATION.md) addresses AUD18-03. Qualify actual Linux/RPC/trace workloads and ingress limits under [host-services](TODO.md#task-host-services); keep final canonicality and on-chain deadlines.

tasks.title: Build live fee history & USD values
tasks.text: Index earned fees and reviewed token prices. Keep revenue received, available rewards and past claims distinct.
acceptance: Index gross earned revenue, actual receipts, allocations and claims as distinct events, with complete deployment-to-present coverage, canonical/reorg reconciliation and unavailable responses when coverage is incomplete.

Define reviewed per-asset USD pricing and 24-hour/all-time valuation. Cumulative raw claimed totals, including claims by previous NFT owners, must not be presented as gross revenue; the selected Pons pool has 0% conventional fees, not the demo's assumed 0.30%.

Use the implemented [conversion history](docs/ROYALTY_REPORTING.md) as a separate denomination record. Never add ETH conversion credits to already-counted source earnings or current ETH claimable. Complete claimed/conversion history does not establish gross earned fees or historical USD value.

tasks.title: Host and monitor the API & indexer
tasks.text: A bounded read-only RPC compatibility probe exists. Pinax passed its initial checks; the documented public endpoint returned HTTP 403 from this environment. Qualify a second provider, production hosting, backfills, reorgs and external alerts. Request-wide deadlines/RPC budgets, SQLite checkpoints and killable serial HTTP workers are implemented; deployment and operating qualification remain open.
acceptance: Publish and qualify the confirmed read API, optional unsigned preparation and ownership/claim-history indexer for the reviewed deployment. Independently verify hashes/configuration and response freshness after all RPC/history reads.
Qualify redundant providers, hosting limits, complete backfill, reorg recovery, structured sanitized logs and off-host alerts. Never host a transaction signer in the frontend read/preparation API.

Independently qualify the schema-2 lifecycle and complete same-chain predecessor history with live consumers: reviewed peer code/ABI/semantics and configuration, archive receipt/state availability, full ingestion reconciliation, retirement-cutoff index retention/backups, request latency at configured bounds and sanitized failure behavior. No partial lifetime sums or automatic unreviewed peer discovery.

Investigate the intermittent RPC HTTP failure observed during price reads. The subsequent paced feed/route observation succeeded but does not prove its cause or provider reliability; qualify bounded retry/failover and snapshot freshness without weakening fail-closed behavior.

[AUD18-03 remediation](reports/api-work-limits/VERIFICATION.md): shared 25-second deadline, expiry shortening, finite logical/physical RPC budgets and 30-second supervised workers are implemented; original expiry reproduction stops before tracing. Qualify real Linux process cleanup, DNS/slow-body/RPC stalls, maximum lineage/history and trace workloads, admission/rate/connection limits and sanitized off-host timeout alerts. A timeout must not leave backend work or partial results.

Qualify the explicit royalty-reporting profile against actual pinned ledger/converter versions and complete history. Exercise currency-null states, strict core/work-limit rejection, predecessor cutoffs and clients that cannot interpret the new availability/eligibility fields; no automatic runtime-pin acceptance.

tasks.title: Inventory NFT holders before replacement
tasks.text: Confirmed owner/code inventory, bounded pages and complete coverage checks flag contracts and delegated accounts for review. The procedure requires a frozen rescan and exact escrow release/claim evidence; actual compatibility qualification remains under canonical recovery.
acceptance: [Scoped verification](reports/holder-preflight/VERIFICATION.md): pinned reads, 1,000-NFT coverage, missing/duplicate/mixed snapshots, reorgs, code/binding drift and limits. Read-only implementation; no actual deployed escrow or marketplace approved.

tasks.title: Collection, artwork & portfolio preview
tasks.text: Browse designs, explore positions, and simulate minting, activation and both reward claims.

tasks.title: Connect real wallet transactions
tasks.text: Wire minting, activation, LP additions and claims to reviewed deployed contracts.
acceptance: Integrate actual wallet transactions and the implemented confirmed API/history/unsigned-preparation service, including the separate royalty ledger, lifetime per-asset claims and indexed ownership. Independently pin/review deployments and calldata; discard drafts on account/chain changes or expiry; freshly simulate/estimate gas, confirm with the user and handle canonical receipts/replacements/reorgs. Bound/chunk portfolio claims. Gross earned fees and USD history require separate data/valuation; raw claimed totals cannot substitute for them.

tasks.title: Show actual holdings & claimable fees
tasks.text: Replace sample positions with wallet ownership, attached LP and separate LP / royalty balances.
acceptance: Use confirmed current ownership, attached LP and separate per-asset individual/collective/royalty balances. Preserve unavailable remote/stale valuations and sticky activation eligibility through artwork downgrades.

Decide whether production labels use raw hashed token IDs or the existing sequential mint ordinal; implement and review matching metadata/UI labels without changing stable custody IDs. Demo #444 is not a promised production identifier.

Integrate current physical LP/share-denominator context, marked NAV vs cumulative input and price-guard unavailable states. Render out-of-range warning plus earliest rebalance eligibility; only fresh authenticated telemetry may supply an estimated next keeper check. The public website is still simulated and was not changed by the backend delta.

Consume [royalty-reporting fields](docs/ROYALTY_REPORTING.md): separate claimable ETH/source currencies, deferred eligibility and unavailable amounts. Converter enabled is not a route quote or scheduled execution. Do not offer signing based solely on a read-only balance response.

tasks.title: Handle the complete transaction journey
tasks.text: Show gas, approvals, confirmation, rejection and recovery when an account, network or receipt changes.
acceptance: Show original contribution value, exact approvals, the 1% execution limit and network gas separately. Rejected or reverted execution may still cost network gas.

Independently review and pin deployments, the immutable 32-operation claim router runtime/bindings and exact calldata. Chunk larger portfolios; recheck owner/assets, simulate and estimate gas immediately before user confirmation. Handle account/network changes, stale drafts, rejection, replacement, failure and canonical receipt/reorg recovery.

Mint/claim drafts have client-enforced expiry, not an on-chain calldata deadline. Discard stale drafts and prepare again; do not describe unsigned backend preparation as signing or live wallet integration.

Use exact decimal uint256 strings for production NFT IDs; never reuse Number-based demo identities. Correct the demo old net-$100 activation wording to gross $100 / 99% deployed before publishing that scoped website change.

tasks.title: Connect live history & cumulative claims
tasks.text: Display verified 24-hour / all-time fees and lifetime claimed totals, including royalties.
acceptance: Display verified 24-hour/all-time earned fees separately from claimable balances. Previously claimed means lifetime per-asset LP plus royalty claims across all prior claims/owners and verified predecessor deployments, not just the last claim.
Connect simulated royalty cards to the separate confirmed royalty ledger and complete event history. Preserve explicit unavailable states when coverage or USD prices are missing.

Keep royalty_conversions as conversion history only; previously_claimed includes actual lifetime LP and royalty payouts across owners and complete configured predecessors. Do not add credited ETH again to claimable or earned totals.

tasks.title: Show execution-time rights when buying an NFT
tasks.text: Refresh accrued balances and explain that the buyer receives what remains unclaimed at transfer. A seller can claim before the sale; do not promise a minimum balance from an earlier listing snapshot.
acceptance: Verify marketplace payment and claims; do not advertise ERC2981 as enforced royalties or a listing's claim balance as guaranteed at purchase.

areas.title: Testing & qualification
areas.caption: Three required testing layers, with source-bound evidence.

tasks.title: Local contract and integration tests
tasks.text: Royalty reporting adds 138 affected Python passes plus 20 supplemental passes, with unchanged Solidity evidence reused and ten getter/26 added-event ABIs checked. Prior royalty scope has 135 affected Solidity cases, 195 scoped Python cases, 31 size gates and 40 source bindings; holder preflight adds 12 cases. These scoped receipts are not a new full regression or production approval.

tasks.title: Robinhood mainnet-fork qualification
tasks.text: The latest targeted ordinary-rebalance case passes against the pinned selected native/Pons venue with current source bindings. Broader historical fork suites retain their recorded sources and blocks. Production feeds, full input routes, gas/strategy settings and services remain unqualified; synthetic prices and mocked authorities/VRF do not close those gates.
acceptance: **Robinhood mainnet fork:** compatibility with the actual ZZZ pool, hook and deployed dependencies. The existing separate hookless-pool tests do not close this gate.
Stage actual Uniswap swaps/entry/maintenance, malicious token/callback behavior, exact approvals/settlement, stale prices, donations and failures.

tasks.title: Robinhood Testnet end-to-end rehearsal
tasks.text: Exercise wallet flows, the website, keeper operations and deployment with explicit records of unavailable or mocked dependencies.
acceptance: **Robinhood Testnet:** wallet flows, website integration, keeper operations and deployment rehearsals, with actual supported services and explicit records of any mocked or unavailable dependencies.
Complete actual Robinhood Testnet end-to-end operation, physical host-loss/key-rotation rehearsal and independent audit/configuration approval.

Exercise actual entry, top-ups, fee funding/claims, royalties, transfers, rebalances, live keeper signing/recovery, indexer backfill/reorgs and alerts. Record mock or unavailable dependencies; Sepolia and local Anvil supplement but do not replace Robinhood-specific qualification.

Treat the local $1 variant as separate test evidence. A public testnet wallet flow still needs a reviewed deployment, services and frontend configuration; do not promote the reduced minimum into production. Any real production defect exposed by rehearsals requires a production fix, focused regression and refreshed source-bound evidence.

tasks.title: Independent audit and release approval
tasks.text: Complete an external audit, remediation, gas/strategy review and final operating/configuration sign-off before any real funds.
acceptance: **Local tests:** minting, activation, rewards, royalties, transfers and security.

Reproduce all Solidity/Python tests for the final frozen production release on supported Ubuntu, retaining exact source revision, compiler settings and full logs. Candidate CI and earlier green CI for `5febe70` do not validate future source changes.

Compile every contract/test/script and check normal runtime/initcode limits, constructor-argument allowance (including the claim router) and current gas; all small bytecode margins require explicit review.
Independently review the final source-bound Slither triage and accepted risks, refreshing analysis if source changes. Completed internal triage does not close the external audit gate.
Complete an independent external security audit, remediation verification and separate deployment/configuration review, then limited staging with approved limits.

Complete production services, creator terms, frozen-release independent audit and operating rehearsals. Real bridging remains blocked by destination capacity admission and provider/recovery qualification.

Complete the seven [security audit workstreams](docs/SECURITY_AUDIT_PLAN.md), including pre-seal implementation and qualification of the selected controlled whole-protocol migration while the source works. Post-halt recovery is deferred; LP migration alone is insufficient. Allocation percentages remain fixed; evaluate any proposed configurability separately.

Fill and independently authenticate the schema-4 production inventory: release-specific source/configuration, code and helper bindings, assets, randomness, parking rehearsal and operating evidence. Its current blocked state is intentional; offline consistency never authorizes deployment, sealing or real funds.

Preserve complete exact-release local/Ubuntu, actual Robinhood mainnet-fork and Robinhood Testnet evidence. Partial/cancelled fork runs and older source snapshots do not qualify the final release; test timeouts must retain partial evidence without counting as a pass.

Keep test-inventory assertions aligned with published fork cases and preserve standard assertion failure reporting. The [CI fixture correction](reports/architecture-evolution-ci/README.md) covers stale expectations for the existing 24 native/Pons plus nine hookless tests; it does not qualify production dependencies.

tasks.title: Verify NFT economic rights at full collection size
tasks.text: Internal ownership, 1,000-NFT payouts, buyback rollback and dual-ledger invariants verified: 531 offline Solidity passes, two intentional fork setup skips; extended rights invariants completed 65,536 calls. This closes the scoped local verification task, not independent audit or production qualification.

tasks.title: Isolated $1 activation rehearsal
tasks.text: A separate local-only build allows $1 gross activation with the unchanged 99% marginal-LP limit and 0.05 ETH mint price. Ten focused Solidity and four generator checks pass. Production source/API/website stay at $100; no public deployment or funds used.

areas.title: Security & audit
areas.caption: Seven audit workstreams. Local checks are partial evidence; independent review and release sign-off remain open. See [the security audit plan](docs/SECURITY_AUDIT_PLAN.md) for acceptance criteria and priorities.

tasks.title: Governance, permissions & sealing
tasks.text: Audit every role, governance controller, configuration and external-module trust boundary for a path around nonredeemable custody. Prove sealed bindings stay fixed and supported asset/feed/route/parameter changes remain bounded; review malicious destinations, lost keys and emergency powers.
acceptance: Independently audit [immediate governance](docs/GOVERNANCE.md): no advance notice window, zero single/batch and migration delays, unchanged proposer/executor permissions, exact-calldata/replay/predecessor checks, canonical locks and guardian/keeper separation. An approved malicious feed, route, provider or successor can act immediately; review multisig security and acknowledge that trust explicitly.

Review governed activation-source enable/disable, future token admission, wrapper implementation/admin changes and disabled-source exit rehearsals. Admitting a source token does not add its conversion route; removing it must not revoke existing LP/reward rights. Ordinary exits remain price-guarded; parked close uses separately approved raw-token bounds. Rehearse governed feed repair without claiming unconditional recovery from external wrapper/bridge failure.

Independently stage paused parking through the sealed governance controller: missing/stale price feeds, failed creator inbox, exact share/LP/custody snapshot, close-only minimums excluding idle/compound/donations, one-sided principal, invalidation/replay/expiry, claims/transfers and fresh-oracle resume. Authenticate current-source evidence in the inventory's mandatory `parking_rehearsal` record.

Review the malicious approved-provider trust demonstration and remote custody powers. Code/configuration hashes and governance approvals do not prove honest destination funding or safe remote administrators. Keep fixed 80/10/5/5; no percentage setter or generic upgrade is authorized.

Independently review the implemented canonical preparation notice: existing controller-only start/cancel, exact notice binding, blocked new economic work and protocol configuration, trailing callback guards, and fixed parking/plan-cancellation drains. Guardian pause and governance controller unpause remain; inherited governance controller roles and scheduling keep their existing rules. The notice grants no successor authority and cannot freeze or export canonical rights.

Independently review/rehearse [mint/pool stop controls](reports/operator-controls/REVIEW.md): disable-only flags, full reopening validation, callback rollback, unchanged roles/canonical locks, obsolete approved operations and explicitly reviewed successor mint-pause state.

tasks.title: Shared LP accounting & economic manipulation
tasks.text: Verify 1,000 independent NFT share accounts through deposits, top-ups, compounding, rebalancing and migrations. Extend local conservation and gas evidence with adversarial prices, donation/front-running, dilution, rounding and multi-asset economic tests on qualified venues.
acceptance: Review creator inboxes, optional wrappers, discretionary payment terms, processing-time eligibility and combined four-bucket/four-inbox costs with all admitted assets. The factory's separate 16-inbox ceiling does not enlarge current Vault capacity. Qualify actual Entry/Pons gas, not only the passing local fixture. Creator payment frequency and percentage remain undecided.

Review [dynamic-liquidity evidence](reports/dynamic-liquidity/VERIFICATION.md): independent price/decimal range vectors, current-NAV entry and compound exclusion, loss/appreciation/replacement/transfer continuity. Extend the bounded local/mock evidence with actual production routes, calibrated strategy backtests and full configuration gas/MEV qualification.

tasks.title: Ownership, claims & allocation rules
tasks.text: Verify all unclaimed balances and fractions follow the NFT, including transfer/claim ordering, callbacks, operators and pending receipt synchronization. Preserve fixed 80/10/5/5 with documented dust and separate funded rarity royalties. Assess configurable splits against practical benefit and added governance risk before any proposal; no percentage setter is implemented or authorized.
acceptance: Independently verify isolated 0.05 ETH mint proceeds, the 1,000-NFT cap, exact 600/300/100 quotas, atomic failure and no reroll/trait override.
Independently verify 80/10/5/5 funding, 90% remote delivery, equal collective membership and index/fractional solvency across transfers, entries and migrations.

Independently review the 5% ERC-2981 request and 100% eligible royalty redistribution in the separate immutable ETH/ERC20 ledger at activated rarity weights 1/2/3. Marketplace payment remains voluntary.

Configure OpenSea creator earnings to the actual `NFT.royaltyRewards()` helper at 5%, verify collection-administration access and each admitted payout asset, and stage a paid sale through receipt, weighted claim and NFT transfer. The current contract requests optional earnings; it does not implement ERC-721-C enforcement.

tasks.title: Oracles, keepers, strategies & MEV
tasks.text: Test compromised keepers, stale/manipulated prices, repeated rebalances, unfavorable swaps and sandwich/MEV costs. Qualify execution bounds, cooldowns, fee/gas budgets and outage policies with actual venues; access control alone does not prevent economic loss or impermanent loss.
acceptance: Qualify gas for 1/100/1,000 NFTs and maximum actual assets/inboxes; prove upkeep scales by shared pool. Backtest range, trigger, cooldown, slippage, impermanent loss, MEV and operating cost. Production strategy parameters remain unset.

Keep the unchanged 12M local combined-workload budget and four-historical-bucket cap. Qualify actual Entry/Pons/token/inbox costs, not only a local shared-pair fixture; refresh normal runtime/initcode gates including constructor arguments for final source.

Independently qualify the implemented 3% loss cap for ordinary rebalance and atomic same-ordered-pair local move/resume, including the cached pre-harvest valuation vector, attributed compound, close/swap/mint costs, idle ceiling, callback repricing, MEV and repeated moves. Initial oracle honesty, venue backing and cumulative erosion remain risks; different-pair and asynchronous bridge enforcement remains open. Activation/top-ups retain 1%.

The new metadata spot/oracle guard and fixed-price rebalance cap require independent review. A per-operation 3% ceiling is not a target cost or a cumulative loss budget. Qualify real close/swap/mint execution, oracle/venue honesty, range/trigger/cooldown choices and outages before funding.

Independently qualify the implemented [range-policy application](docs/RANGE_POLICY_UPDATES.md): the governance-approved pool config authorizes a current-tick mismatch at the stored center through ordinary rebalance, preserving cooldown, oracle/minima, 3% aggregate/idle limits and NFT rights. Review repeated-change costs and current-config execution/resimulation; no separately privileged force path or config-version lock is added. [Scoped evidence](reports/range-policy/VERIFICATION.md) is not live strategy qualification.

User decision 2026-10-19: keep the 3% per-operation cap only, no rolling/cumulative loss breaker. Monitor cumulative turnover/MEV/gas costs and rehearse operator pause/parameter recovery; see [range management](docs/OPERATOR_MANUAL.md#range-and-strategy).

tasks.title: External dependencies & receipt backing
tasks.text: Review Uniswap v4, Pons, creator payments, tokens/wrappers, oracles, randomness and future bridges for upgrades, compromise, outages and unexpected behavior. Reconcile every asset liability to actual receipts; test quarantine, duplicate/delayed funding, token failure and provider/destination change.
acceptance: Independently qualify implemented royalty-token outage isolation: failed optional balance reads defer only new membership for that currency. Recovery protects the earlier cohort and exact liabilities. Single-asset healthy claims continue, while syncAll and exact unreadable canonical backing can still fail. Do not blindly skip old receipt/eligibility checkpoints.

The [royalty conversion and outage candidate](docs/ROYALTY_SETTLEMENT.md) isolates optional-token activation failures and preserves earned balances. Actual token/wrapper/route behavior, runtime inventory, eligibility UI and live recovery still require qualification; native ETH has no external ERC20 balance query.

tasks.title: Whole-protocol recovery & canonical chain loss
tasks.text: Same-chain handoff candidate now carries complete ownership, inventory, shares, both reward ledgers and exact backing, with atomic retirement/activation, restored abort and late forwarding. Qualify it and complete cross-chain finality, channel closure and lineage/transport before sealing; post-halt recovery stays deferred.
acceptance: Implement and independently qualify the accepted 2026-10-17 direction: planned whole-protocol migration while the source chain works. Preserve canonical NFT ownership and both funded ledgers, not just LP location. Post-halt recovery is deferred; no emergency recovery authority is authorized.

For any canonical transfer, specify one successor epoch and source freeze, NFT ownership/traits/shares, LP and royalty accruals/fractions/backing, in-flight messages and old-chain restart/replay policy. A snapshot or remote LP location ACK does not revoke old ownership.

Implement the selected verified-finality requirement: destination activation must authenticate finalized source retirement through an independently qualified chain-specific proof mechanism. No multisig/manual override, timeout activation or signer-attestation fallback is authorized. The concrete verifier/provider and finality configuration remain unselected; source terminal commitment must precede successor rights and cannot be reversed afterward.

Drain original ordered VRF/reveal and resolve in-flight custody/reward messages before freeze. The user selected provider qualification plus reveal drain; no pending-request carry is being added. Preserve exact IDs/traits, remaining supply/quota/inventory, owners and per-asset liabilities/fractions; never recreate balances from website data.

Retain safe handling of late old creator/royalty receipts and historical marketplace receivers. No double claims, duplicated canonical NFTs, erased backed obligations, principal refunds or arbitrary administrator transfers.

For principal conversion during relocation, enforce the agreed aggregate 3% per migrating bucket, gas separate, without offsetting one bucket loss against another bucket gain or spending claimable rewards. The implemented atomic local same-pair budget does not yet supply cross-chain aggregate enforcement.

Independently qualify the implemented same-chain cutoff, bounded exact export/import, classified backing, single-successor retirement, full/partial abort and late-forwarding paths. Benchmark atomic cutoff capture, ordered per-domain settlement, eight-row batches, each funding leg and final activation across 1,000 NFTs, four historical buckets, 32 LP assets, reachable funded inboxes and 17 royalty slots under unchanged limits.

Implement authenticated closure for historically used bridge channels and separate stable origin lineage from live canonical routing in a new message version. The current direct handoff rejects any legacy bridge activity and an imported successor cannot initiate v3 principal bridging; those restrictions are not a completed future-chain design.

Review compatible successor templates, code/configuration commitments and all owner/helper bindings. On 2026-10-17 the user explicitly accepted governance approval of different reviewed replacement code. A malicious approved replacement could divert LP; code hashes alone do not prove nonredeemability. This accepted trust does not waive exact backing, single-successor/source-retirement or verified-finality requirements.

Rehearse contract-holder and marketplace escrow compatibility with the new collection address. Import preserves owner addresses without ERC721 callbacks and cannot prove an old escrow can release a replacement NFT. Verify retirement notices, source/destination metadata, old listings and historical royalty receiver forwarding. The [read-only preflight](docs/HOLDER_PREFLIGHT.md) now inventories pinned ownership/code and flags unresolved holders. Repeat after freeze; incomplete coverage or unreviewed escrow release behavior prevents operational sign-off.

Historical canonical-handoff qualification recorded 582 regression cases plus 34 focused handoff cases, two opt-in fork setup skips, repaired bridge fixtures and three cold-gas suites. These retain their original source scope. The latest Vault/metadata changes have separate [dynamic-liquidity evidence](reports/dynamic-liquidity/VERIFICATION.md), not a new complete handoff regression. Preserve failed diagnostics, verify exact-commit Ubuntu CI and obtain independent review plus real operating qualification before release.

Qualify the selected [provider-and-drain operator policy](docs/OPERATOR_MANUAL.md#whole-collection-replacement) against AUD18-02: no new mints during preparation, all original draws finalized before freeze. An unfulfilled request can still block replacement; document postponement/cancellation and provider escalation. No reroll/admin override/pending-request carry is authorized.

tasks.title: Cross-contract & infrastructure audit
tasks.text: Audit complete transaction paths and failure rollback across contracts, frontend, API/indexer, deployment, keys and keeper services. Rehearse reorgs, replay, stale or compromised data, wrong-chain signing, RPC failure, restore/rotation and monitoring. Independent review and operational sign-off remain open.
acceptance: The [review of all October 18 changes](reports/daily-security-20261018/REVIEW.md) records source inspection, exact evidence hashes, one new availability reproduction, and accepted governance/economic plus VRF/escrow recovery risks. It identifies no new unauthorized withdrawal path but does not close independent audit, service qualification or final-release testing. Resolve findings under their owning tasks without silently adding governance delays.

areas.title: Launch & operations
areas.caption: Decisions and rehearsals before real funds.

tasks.title: Select authorities & price services
tasks.text: Confirm governance, guardian, keeper and mint-recipient addresses, plus reliable USD pricing and outage policies.
acceptance: Supply reviewed feeds, decimals, denomination, heartbeat/sequencer/outage policy and admitted tokens on every chain.

Independently review and stage sequencer policy replacement through the actual sealed governance controller, including failed old feeds, unchanged healthy feeds, code changes and recovery grace. Bootstrap references are not independent reviews, and proxy runtime pins do not pin their implementations. Confirm an actual supported Robinhood source or explicitly reviewed no-feed chain policy; no ZZZ/USD feed is selected.
Select and verify multisig/keeper/guardian/mint-recipient authorities, zero-delay governance controller and fixed module bindings; prohibit mint/LP/royalty receiver collisions.

Complete the address inventory: governance signers/threshold, guardian, keeper, mint recipient, temporary bootstrap, provider-specific VRF subscription ownership and agreed creator payer; 21 fixed core contracts (controller plus 20 sealed modules), eight automatically created helpers/factories, later creator inboxes and reviewed chain-specific dependencies. Observe canonical lifecycle/origin, companion owners and factory bindings. Timelock is a contract, the template executor is open, royalties use NFT.royaltyRewards(), and no burn wallet is required.

tasks.title: Finalize creator revenue-sharing terms
tasks.text: Agree the fee basis, liquidity-share measurement, payout asset, frequency and authorized payer. Only actual receipts fund rewards.
acceptance: Confirm terms with the pool creator: percentage and calculation basis, payout asset/network, payment frequency, authorized payer/configurer and actual PoPL receiver. Terms were explicitly deferred on 2026-10-15; receipt-driven implementation must not imply guaranteed revenue. Stage a payment through allocation and holder claim.

Agree and qualify the proposed active-liquidity measurement policy: fee-weighted or time-weighted, epoch length, snapshot frequency/gap limits, finality, complete fee events, tick-crossing approximation, cross-asset payout conversion, rounding and independent receipt reconciliation. Rehearse the complete data-to-payment-to-holder-claim cycle. The implemented calculator has no payout authority and does not prove creator acceptance.

tasks.title: Publish artwork & operate metadata refresh
tasks.text: The IPFS upload bundle and refresh watcher are prepared. Pin the files, verify the CID and test marketplace updates.
acceptance: Stage live oracle/NAV thresholds, downward evolution and remote/stale unavailable labels; claims and migration must remain independent of metadata price reads.

Stage the implemented watcher with actual feeds, reviewed NFT runtime pins, RPC limits, confirmation recovery and gas budgets. Publish/pin the complete 2,784-state artwork manifest and independently verify its root, every path and actual marketplace rendering/ERC-4906 cache refresh.

Select an IPFS pinning provider and publish the verified complete artwork bundle; independently verify the resulting CID, all renderer paths and ongoing pin availability. Provider selection and publication were deferred; preparing a bundle alone does not establish hosting.

Exercise the added real strategy price guard, unavailable/recovery notifications and disabled-operations honest valuation in a live watcher/marketplace rehearsal; the local metadata suite does not establish cache behavior.

tasks.title: Harden keeper recovery and monitoring
tasks.text: Recovery, preparation and strict canonical lifecycle guards are implemented in the published candidate. Locked canonical states stop all new submissions while receipt recovery continues. Existing staging is unchanged; exact deployment compatibility, RPC/fees, alerts and operating review remain open.
acceptance: Stage keeper keystore isolation, nonce/receipt recovery, RPC failover, budgets, indexer backfill/reorgs, alerts and Unix state locking. The supplied systemd unit defaults to dry run.

Qualify canonical-hash RPC selectors for every activation state read, stale-snapshot rejection, strict receipt recovery across midnight/reorgs, and the chain's complete L2/L1 fee reporting. Offline mocks do not establish provider support or complete real network costs.
Qualify independent production alerts/backups/retention, redundant RPCs and complete real fee accounting.

Qualify preparationActive() and canonicalState() against the exact deployment and keeper. Missing/malformed/reverted getters fail closed. Frozen/importing/retired/cancelled states block all new maintenance/drain/metadata submissions; canonical receipt recovery continues. Recheck state before simulation, after gas estimation and before intent persistence. The local 88-case targeted receipt does not update the older staging fixture/keeper or replace a new operating rehearsal.

Add/review authenticated freshness-bounded next-check/last-success telemetry for frontend warnings; do not infer an execution promise from a 600-second poll example. Offline, delayed, paused, pending or budget-limited operation must be explicit. Qualify the new aggregate rebalance guard against the exact keeper deployment.

tasks.title: Rehearse keeper outage & server recovery
tasks.text: Historical 2026-10-16 evidence: 209 Ubuntu safety tests and 14 process rehearsals pass; the same 14 scenarios pass under the isolated server account. Actual systemd crash/restart and off-host snapshot round-trip restore passed. Sustained soak, physical host loss and governance key rotation remain open. Verify off-host backups, health/log alert delivery, permissions/disk failures and actual Linux service restart/locking. Local guards are not production operating evidence.

Finish and review sustained multi-day staging; preserve observation gaps. The 30-minute desktop-dependent chat health monitor was paused at the user's request on 2026-10-17. It supplies no subsequent observations; do not restart it without authorization. The isolated server service was not stopped by pausing the monitor.

Rehearse [operator manual](docs/OPERATOR_MANUAL.md) scenarios with exact production roles/configuration: asset/pool stops, range changes, dependency outage/parking/resume, host/key recovery, reveal drain and whole-collection abort. Manual updates are required for every management behavior change under [maintenance rules](docs/TODO_WORKFLOW.md); a written runbook is not rehearsal evidence.

tasks.text: Review admitted token upgrade, blacklist, rebase and transfer behavior. Approve admitted-token outage/upgrade/blacklist behavior and economic value of repeated sub-20-raw-unit incumbent dust settlements.

areas.title: Future migration
areas.caption: A separate phase. Disabled at initial launch.

tasks.title: Governed migration framework
tasks.text: Timelocked compatible-asset routes preserve fixed home identity and NFT allocations. Local same-pair move/resume now has a 3% aggregate loss cap, and a cancellable canonical preparation notice stops new work while rights and drains remain available. The same-chain canonical handoff candidate now carries ownership and accounting. Different-pair conversion, arbitrary local venues and cross-chain canonical relocation remain unimplemented.

tasks.text: Permanent idempotent local admission is implemented with targeted capacity, switching, return and None-state regressions. Remote reservation authentication, independent review and real-provider qualification remain open.
acceptance: Implement and independently review permanent destination capacity admission before delivery. Verify the repaired reserved-arrival path, local/remote competition, aliases, duplicate registration, malformed-import rollback, None-state consumers and full-cap returns. Real bridging remains disabled pending independent admission/provider review.

Authenticate confirmed destination admission before departure. The source does not verify a remote capacity proof; local idempotent reservation alone does not qualify an arbitrary provider or sealed old destination.

tasks.text: Review real transport providers, backing and repeated migrations; implement funded compounding when LP stays on another chain.
acceptance: Independently review real provider SDK wrappers, backing/equivalent token semantics, channels, finality, exact funding and recovery.
Stage canonical -> satellite -> satellite -> home -> revisit with actual providers, duplicate/reordered/forged/underfunded receipts, ACK epochs, pauses, old-policy and historical reward paths.
Verify destination reservations, frozen canonical shares/membership, no remint/principal refund, legacy liability barriers, and governance trust for every new destination.

Rehearse source-oracle-independent departure of an already Parked bucket with designated compound reserves, retained `remoteSettled` barrier, exact attributed transfers, destination valuation and reviewed provider recovery. Parking does not waive bridge backing or enable arbitrary conversion.

Review each future destination and onboard its immutable policy/routes through the governance controller before economic migration. Authenticate provider SDKs, delivery fees, delayed receipts, failure/recovery and retained historical routes; future chains, arbitrary conversions and satellite top-ups are not automatically supported.

Resolve permanent-relocation compounding: the canonical creator receiver reserves its 5% compounding share at home while principal is remote. Remote reinvestment needs a separately reviewed funded bridge/top-up design; the current path waits for return.
